accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:full-law-sharpness
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Sharpness is conditional on the continuous globally Lipschitz baseline-trend completion class and the heterogeneous-baseline conditional mean-movement bound.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The weighted WAOSS set is sharp over the explicitly declared compatible-completion subclass under these substantive conditions.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:uniform-band-to-program and prop:honest-outer-ci
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Uniform inference is conditional on known finite-rectangle support, fixed Hölder smoothness, density bounds, bounded outcomes, and denominator separation.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The outer interval is uniformly honest over the stated regular subclass, not over unrestricted panel laws.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and introductory description of the discrete-support LP construction
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies discrete X and W supports, uses linear shape restrictions to form an identified interval for a linear functional, and computes endpoints through finite linear programs.
The article gives calibrated projection confidence intervals with uniform asymptotic coverage for finite moment-(in)equality systems and optimizes relaxed sample constraints.

The paper develops consistency, standard errors, bias reduction, and faster convergence for average partial effects with stayers and slow movers; it does not formulate a point-to-set minimax transition.
